description: Permanent regression corpus for the AMD classifier. Each entry pins the classifier's ACTUAL output on that file at the time it was added (knownStatus/knownConfidence) — that is what the regression test asserts against, so a future model/pipeline change that silently shifts a result gets caught. groundTruthLabel is this project's best real-world label for the source recording, independent of what the model currently says; where it differs from knownStatus, that's a documented accuracy gap, not a bug in the test. Every clip is at least 5s (most are 8s+); nothing shorter was kept.
format: 16 kHz, mono, signed 16-bit little-endian PCM, no header (matches ../../amd/fixtures' fixture.pcm convention)
generatedWith: ffmpeg -ar 16000 -ac 1 -f s16le, trimmed to the leading portion of each source (see trimmedTo per entry)

entries.note: Known accuracy gap: the model reads this real human narration as MACHINE at near-toss-up confidence, likely because Asterisk's demo-congrats is formally scripted, evenly-paced narration rather than spontaneous conversational speech — compare to human-2..human-11 below, which are spontaneous and all classify correctly at high confidence. Kept specifically to track this narration-vs-conversation gap.
